verdict.rationale: HMRC runs its own live, versioned REST API platform (Making Tax Digital). Its docs route income-tax quarterly updates and filing through compatible software, so some UI functions do have an API path. However, sign-up, VAT registration, employer registration and Corporation Tax management are documented only as online-service or business-tax-account (UI) flows, so the evidence does not show API parity. Missing for 10: evidence that registration, sign-up, VAT and Corporation Tax actions are available via the API; a documented statement of API/UI feature parity; accessible API reference documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You’ll need to use software that works with Making Tax Digital for Income Tax to send any missed quarterly updates for the year so far.
a live, versioned production REST platform (Making Tax Digital) answering with a structured error contract
